name: bird_hoot_quirk1
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this Hoot reference into one production key frame. Keep exactly the same pale tawny cream round owl, heart-shaped white facial disc, amber eyes, grey-brown speckled wings, tiny star-patterned blue nightcap, NO ear tufts. Preserve the same square canvas, BODY SCALE and torso location, camera, feather texture and warm upper-left lighting. Quirk key pose A: turn the HEAD toward LEFT to look back over left shoulder, while body and feet remain facing right in the same position. Natural owl head rotation, no body twist, retain facial disc and cap. Whole bird safely within canvas, never scale body down to fit wings. Transparent alpha background, single bird, no floor, shadow, border, text or decorations.
